operator.continuation: Read the retained parcel_criteria_selection from the actual acquisition result and call parcel_criteria.prepare.

model_contracts.study_domain: Reporting geometry union full original geometries of every selected parcel, preserving original parcel/reporting binding and geometry context.
model_contracts.soil_reuse: Existing SOIL_K_NATIVE original vector or actual completed native soil capture, original MUKEY/AOI geometry and query masks.
model_contracts.soil_extension: Query actual acquisition-domain difference from retained original AOI coverage; retain overlapping fragments with native identity and union downstream.
model_contracts.default_hydric: hydclprs=100 with only Yes among positive/unknown-weight components; certainty also retains hydclprs=0 with No components.
model_contracts.predominant: Original hydclprs >=66, an explicit whole-map-unit interpretation.
model_contracts.floodplain: Original FEMA NFHL28 metadata and native ID/CRS, selected exact SFHA_TF=T, known-negative F zones excluding D/unmapped/unknown.
model_contracts.empty_selections: Actual features=[] selected source is consumable with actual nonempty certainty coverage. Zero certainty count emits no certainty binding.
model_contracts.native_mass_metrics: Existing NDR/SDR quantities and selected model-family contracts are consumed through the maintained Conservation workflow.

current_soil_component.reuse: Current maintained soil_sources.Sda transport/table API and original soil_region geometry-capture companions

existing_compatibility.operation_lock: Independent .capture.lock; Workspace owns each import transaction
existing_compatibility.source_resume: Complete original family files and provider responses are reused. Actual source edition IDs and edition-specific manifests remain retained.

native_receiving.execution: Invoke the source acquisition on the actual current study/domain and reuse the original soil vector/capture when present.
outputs: Prepared original parcel-criteria table and coverage
native_receiving.routing: Current source owners ASTRA-GIS12/ECO-SOURCE12/ESI-178D through the existing native source work thread
